quests.name: Deadly Desert Venom

quests.name: Securing the Supply Lines
quests.summary: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.

quests.name: The Spirits of Southwind
quests.summary: Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village, and then return to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.

quests.name: Hive in the Tower
quests.summary: Scale the tower of Southwind Village and locate a means to stir the silithid hive into activity.  Bring back anything unusual you may uncover when doing so to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.

quests.name: Noggle's Last Hope
quests.summary: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.

quests.name: Stepping Up Security

quests.name: Umber, Archivist
quests.summary: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: Noggle's Lost Satchel
quests.summary: Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of Silithus and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.

quests.name: The Twilight Mystery
quests.summary: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.

quests.name: Still Believing
quests.summary: Find any more encrypted texts?  Bring me a good batch of them, this decoding work takes some time.

quests.name: The Deserter
quests.summary: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.

quests.name: True Believers
quests.summary: Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts.

quests.name: Wanted - Deathclasp, Terror of the Sands
quests.summary: Bring Deathclasp's Pincer to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard.

quests.name: A Humble Offering

quests.name: A Pawn on the Eternal Board
quests.summary: Learn all that you can of the past, then speak with Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

quests.name: A Terrible Purpose
quests.summary: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.

quests.name: Abyssal Contacts
quests.summary: Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to destroy an Abyssal Templar and bring him an Abyssal Crest as proof of the deed. Rewards Bag of Spoils.

quests.name: Abyssal Crests
quests.summary: You've proved you can handle yourself in a fight, <name>.  Let's keep the pressure up on the Twilight's Hammer.  Go fight some more Abyssal Templars, I'll reward you with some of the stuff Huum and I have found in battle.

quests.name: Abyssal Scepters
quests.summary: You've truly exceeded all my expectations, <name>.  You've been taking on opponents that Huum and I would think long and hard before engaging.At this point the best I can do is to continue rewarding your efforts in the fight against the Twilight's Hammer and their overlords.Bring me more abyssal scepters and I'll do my best to give you a suitable reward.

quests.name: Abyssal Signets
quests.summary: You've shown you're more than capable of taking on an Abyssal Duke, <name>.  I'm always one to promote good habits.  Bring me more signets and I'll give you a reward.

quests.name: Allegiance to Cenarion Circle
quests.summary: Even if you have no need for the material rewards we offer, these badges still mark our mutual trust and friendship.Bring them to me.  I'll make due note of your service should your performance go above and beyond the call of duty.

quests.name: Anachronos
quests.summary: Seek out Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

quests.name: Bang a Gong!
quests.summary: The Scarab Gong looms ominously before you. Steel yourself, <name>; for once the Scarab Gong is rung, the gates of Ahn'Qiraj will be opened.From the slackened maw of the beast can only come chaos and destruction. Defend your people!

Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers, obtain Signed Field Duty Papers and bring them to Windcaller Kaldon in Cenarion Hold.Note: Healing or casting beneficial spells on a member of the Orgrimmar Legion will flag you for PvP.

quests.name: Field Duty Papers
quests.summary: I take it you want those papers signed, lad?

quests.name: Field Duty Papers
quests.summary: Field duty papers?  What manner of nonsense is this, <name>?

Return to Rutgar Glyphshaper when you complete this task.

quests.summary: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to find his beloved Natalia. The information that you gathered points to Hive'Regal in the south as being the area in which you may find Mistress Natalia Mar'alith.Do not forget to visit the dwarves at Bronzebeard's camp before venturing into the hive. They might have some additional work and advice for you.And <name>, remember the Commander's words: "Do what you must..."
